#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Morpha — generative-AI logo generator.

Every form in the mark is produced by the same polar-harmonic
"pebble" function with a different seed: one algorithm, many
generations.  That is the brand idea made literal in the geometry.

Outputs clean, flat, few-node SVG paths (Catmull-Rom -> cubic Bezier).
Standard library only.
"""
import math

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- palette
INK   = "#2B2620"   # warm near-black
STONE = "#A39885"   # taupe / stone
CLAY  = "#C2B198"   # pale clay
SAND  = "#E7DFD0"   # sand
BONE  = "#F5F1E9"   # warm paper
GREY  = "#6E655A"   # warm mid-grey

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- geometry
def pebble_points(cx, cy, r, harmonics, rot=0.0, squash=1.0, n=10):
    """Polar-harmonic blob. harmonics = [(k, amp, phase), ...]."""
    pts = []
    for i in range(n):
        t = 2 * math.pi * i / n
        rad = r * (1.0 + sum(a * math.cos(k * t + p) for k, a, p in harmonics))
        x = rad * math.cos(t)
        y = rad * math.sin(t) * squash
        xr = x * math.cos(rot) - y * math.sin(rot)
        yr = x * math.sin(rot) + y * math.cos(rot)
        pts.append((cx + xr, cy + yr))
    return pts

def closed_path(pts):
    """Catmull-Rom spline through pts -> smooth closed cubic path."""
    n = len(pts)
    d = [f"M{pts[0][0]:.2f},{pts[0][1]:.2f}"]
    for i in range(n):
        p0 = pts[(i - 1) % n]; p1 = pts[i]; p2 = pts[(i + 1) % n]; p3 = pts[(i + 2) % n]
        c1 = (p1[0] + (p2[0] - p0[0]) / 6, p1[1] + (p2[1] - p0[1]) / 6)
        c2 = (p2[0] - (p3[0] - p1[0]) / 6, p2[1] - (p3[1] - p1[1]) / 6)
        d.append(f"C{c1[0]:.2f},{c1[1]:.2f} {c2[0]:.2f},{c2[1]:.2f} {p2[0]:.2f},{p2[1]:.2f}")
    return "".join(d) + "Z"

# Seeds: (k, amp, phase) sets — same family, different generations
SEED_MAIN  = [(2, 0.055, 0.6), (3, 0.045, 2.4), (4, 0.018, 1.1)]
SEED_BUD   = [(2, 0.070, 2.9), (3, 0.050, 0.4), (4, 0.020, 3.6)]
SEED_SPORE = [(2, 0.060, 1.7), (3, 0.040, 4.2)]
SEED_ALT   = [(2, 0.080, 4.0), (3, 0.055, 1.9), (4, 0.022, 0.2)]

def pebble(cx, cy, r, seed, rot=0.0, squash=1.0, n=10):
    return closed_path(pebble_points(cx, cy, r, seed, rot, squash, n))

from logo import *

def mark_v1(ink=INK, mid=STONE, pale=CLAY):
    """Budding / cell division, diagonal ascent, nucleus knocked out."""
    main = pebble(102, 140, 70, SEED_MAIN, rot=0.35, squash=0.94)
    nucleus = pebble(88, 128, 15, SEED_SPORE, rot=1.2)
    bud = pebble(172, 74, 41, SEED_BUD, rot=0.8, squash=0.96)
    spore = pebble(215, 128, 12, SEED_SPORE, rot=0.4)
    return (f'<path d="{main}{nucleus}" fill="{ink}" fill-rule="evenodd"/>'
            f'<path d="{bud}" fill="{mid}"/>'
            f'<path d="{spore}" fill="{pale}"/>')

def mark_v2(ink=INK, mid=STONE, pale=CLAY):
    """Mitosis pair, side by side, sharing a pinch."""
    a = pebble(88, 122, 62, SEED_MAIN, rot=0.2, squash=0.98)
    b = pebble(168, 112, 52, SEED_ALT, rot=1.1, squash=0.95)
    s = pebble(128, 52, 11, SEED_SPORE)
    return (f'<path d="{a}" fill="{ink}"/>'
            f'<path d="{b}" fill="{mid}"/>'
            f'<path d="{s}" fill="{pale}"/>')

def mark_v3(ink=INK, mid=STONE, pale=CLAY):
    """Stacked river stones (cairn), generative accumulation."""
    base = pebble(120, 176, 66, SEED_MAIN, rot=0.1, squash=0.62)
    midp = pebble(116, 118, 48, SEED_BUD, rot=0.5, squash=0.70)
    top  = pebble(124, 74, 30, SEED_ALT, rot=0.9, squash=0.78)
    dot  = pebble(126, 34, 9, SEED_SPORE)
    return (f'<path d="{base}" fill="{ink}"/>'
            f'<path d="{midp}" fill="{mid}"/>'
            f'<path d="{top}" fill="{pale}"/>'
            f'<path d="{dot}" fill="{mid}"/>')

def mark_v4(ink=INK, mid=STONE, pale=CLAY):
    """Single seed with knocked-out sprout curve + spore."""
    body = pebble(112, 128, 76, SEED_MAIN, rot=0.5, squash=1.06)

    spore = pebble(196, 62, 13, SEED_SPORE)
    bud = pebble(186, 108, 24, SEED_BUD, rot=0.7)
    return (f'<path d="{body}{sprout}" fill="{ink}" fill-rule="evenodd"/>'
            f'<path d="{bud}" fill="{mid}"/>'
            f'<path d="{spore}" fill="{pale}"/>')

def mark_v1b(ink=INK, mid=STONE, pale=CLAY):
    """V1 without nucleus hole, spore on the ascent diagonal."""
    main = pebble(100, 142, 70, SEED_MAIN, rot=0.35, squash=0.94)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Morpha — logo for a generative AI company.

Concept: cell division / budding stones. A parent "pebble" carries an
opening growth-ring crescent, a younger stone buds from its upper right,
and a spore escapes along the same diagonal: one form generating the next.

Every stone — and every bowl in the custom monoline wordmark — is drawn
by the same polar-harmonic pebble function with a different seed, so the
geometry is itself generative: one algorithm, many generations.

Palette is warm neutrals only. Output is flat, few-node SVG paths
(Catmull-Rom -> cubic Bezier). Standard library only.
"""
import math

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ palette
INK   = "#2B2620"   # warm near-black
MID   = "#7A7062"   # warm mid-grey (the bud)
STONE = "#A39885"   # stone
CLAY  = "#C2B198"   # pale clay (the spore)
SAND  = "#E7DFD0"   # sand
BONE  = "#F5F1E9"   # warm paper
GREY  = "#6E655A"   # warm grey (text)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------- seeds
S_MAIN  = [(2, 0.050, 0.5), (3, 0.030, 2.2)]
S_BUD   = [(2, 0.055, 2.6), (3, 0.032, 0.8)]
S_SPORE = [(2, 0.045, 1.4), (3, 0.025, 3.9)]
S_LET   = [(2, 0.030, 1.1), (3, 0.018, 0.4)]   # letter bowls: near-round

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- geometry
def pebble_points(cx, cy, r, harmonics, rot=0.0, squash=1.0, n=12):
    pts = []
    for i in range(n):
        t = 2 * math.pi * i / n
        rad = r * (1.0 + sum(a * math.cos(k * t + p) for k, a, p in harmonics))
        x = rad * math.cos(t)
        y = rad * math.sin(t) * squash
        pts.append((cx + x * math.cos(rot) - y * math.sin(rot),
                    cy + x * math.sin(rot) + y * math.cos(rot)))
    return pts

def closed_path(pts):
    n = len(pts)
    d = [f"M{pts[0][0]:.2f},{pts[0][1]:.2f}"]
    for i in range(n):
        p0 = pts[(i - 1) % n]; p1 = pts[i]; p2 = pts[(i + 1) % n]; p3 = pts[(i + 2) % n]
        c1 = (p1[0] + (p2[0] - p0[0]) / 6, p1[1] + (p2[1] - p0[1]) / 6)
        c2 = (p2[0] - (p3[0] - p1[0]) / 6, p2[1] - (p3[1] - p1[1]) / 6)
        d.append(f"C{c1[0]:.2f},{c1[1]:.2f} {c2[0]:.2f},{c2[1]:.2f} {p2[0]:.2f},{p2[1]:.2f}")
    return "".join(d) + "Z"

def stone(cx, cy, r, seed, rot=0.0, squash=1.0, n=12):
    return closed_path(pebble_points(cx, cy, r, seed, rot, squash, n))

def _local_pts(cx, cy, r, seed, rot, squash, angles, scale=1.0):
    pts = []
    for t in angles:
        rad = r * scale * (1.0 + sum(a * math.cos(k * t + p) for k, a, p in seed))
        x = rad * math.cos(t); y = rad * math.sin(t) * squash
        pts.append((cx + x * math.cos(rot) - y * math.sin(rot),
                    cy + x * math.sin(rot) + y * math.cos(rot)))
    return pts

def arc_band(cx, cy, r, seed, rot, squash, t0, t1, s_mid=0.65, width=0.105, steps=24):
    """Tapered crescent following the stone's own contour (growth ring)."""
    angs = [t0 + (t1 - t0) * i / steps for i in range(steps + 1)]
    outer, inner = [], []
    for i, t in enumerate(angs):
        w = width * math.sin(math.pi * i / steps) ** 0.55
        outer += _local_pts(cx, cy, r, seed, rot, squash, [t], s_mid + w / 2)
        inner += _local_pts(cx, cy, r, seed, rot, squash, [t], s_mid - w / 2)
    return closed_path(outer + inner[::-1])

# -------------------------------------------------------------------- mark
# Drawn in a 240x240 field. phase/morph params enable the animated version.
MAIN = (96, 146, 66, 0.55, 0.86)
BUD  = (152, 94, 44, 0.55, 0.88)
SPORE = (208, 42, 12, 0.40, 1.00)

def _morph(seed, m):
    """Shift harmonic phases by m (radians, scaled per harmonic)."""
    return [(k, a, p + m * (0.9 if k == 2 else 1.4)) for k, a, p in seed]

def mark(ink=INK, mid=MID, pale=CLAY, morph=0.0, bud_shift=0.0, spore_r=None):
    cx, cy, r, rot, sq = MAIN
    sm = _morph(S_MAIN, morph)
    main = stone(cx, cy, r, sm, rot, sq)
    band = arc_band(cx, cy, r, sm, rot, sq, 0.95, 4.10)
    bx, by, br, brot, bsq = BUD
    bud = stone(bx + bud_shift * 0.7, by - bud_shift * 0.7, br, _morph(S_BUD, morph * 1.2), brot, bsq)
    sx, sy, sr, srot, ssq = SPORE
    spore = stone(sx, sy, spore_r or sr, _morph(S_SPORE, morph), srot, ssq)
    return (f'<path d="{main}{band}" fill="{ink}" fill-rule="evenodd"/>'
            f'<path d="{bud}" fill="{mid}"/>'
            f'<path d="{spore}" fill="{pale}"/>')

def mark_bbox(pad=0.0):
    pts = []
    for (cx, cy, r, rot, sq), seed in [(MAIN, S_MAIN), (BUD, S_BUD), (SPORE, S_SPORE)]:
        pts += pebble_points(cx, cy, r, seed, rot, sq, n=96)
    xs = [p[0] for p in pts]; ys = [p[1] for p in pts]
    return min(xs) - pad, min(ys) - pad, max(xs) + pad, max(ys) + pad

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- wordmark
# Custom monoline lowercase. Baseline B, x-height T, ascender A, descender D.
B, T, A, D = 100, 46, 18, 130
SW = 11.5

def _bowl(cx, cy, r, squash=1.05):
    return stone(cx, cy, r, S_LET, 0.18, squash)

def _g_m():
    return (f"M8,{B} L8,62 C8,40 41,40 41,62 L41,{B} "
            f"M41,62 C41,40 74,40 74,62 L74,{B}"), 88

def _g_o():
    return _bowl(30, 73, 26.5), 62

def _g_r():
    return f"M9,{B} L9,60 C11,43 26,39 36,46 C43,51 44,62 37,74", 50

def _g_p():
    return (f"M11,{D} L11,64", _bowl(34, 68, 24.5)), 66

def _g_h():
    return (f"M9,{B} L9,{A} "
            f"M9,62 C9,40 45,40 45,62 L45,{B}"), 60

def _g_a():
    return ("M52,60 L52,90 C52,99 56,103 62,102", _bowl(27, 73, 26.5)), 70

GLYPHS = {"m": _g_m, "o": _g_o, "r": _g_r, "p": _g_p, "h": _g_h, "a": _g_a}

def wordmark(word="morpha", col=INK, tracking=3, sw=SW):
    """Returns (svg, width, (top, bottom)) in local units."""
    x = 0; parts = []
    for ch in word:
        res, adv = GLYPHS[ch]()
        for d in (res if isinstance(res, tuple) else (res,)):
            parts.append(f'<path d="{d}" transform="translate({x:.1f},0)" fill="none" '
                         f'stroke="{col}" stroke-width="{sw}" stroke-linecap="round" '
                         f'stroke-linejoin="round"/>')
        x += adv + tracking
    return "".join(parts), x - tracking, (A - sw / 2, D + sw / 2)

WM_W = wordmark()[1]          # 411
WM_TOP, WM_BOT = A - SW / 2, D + SW / 2
XHEIGHT = B - T               # 54

# ----------------------------------------------------------------- lockups
def svg_doc(viewbox, body, title="Morpha logo"):
    x, y, w, h = viewbox
    return (f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" '
            f'viewBox="{x:.1f} {y:.1f} {w:.1f} {h:.1f}" role="img">'
            f'<title>{title}</title>{body}</svg>\n')

def mark_svg(ink=INK, mid=MID, pale=CLAY, pad=6):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = mark_bbox(pad)
    return svg_doc((x0, y0, x1 - x0, y1 - y0), mark(ink, mid, pale), "Morpha mark")

def horizontal_svg(ink=INK, mid=MID, pale=CLAY, wm_col=None, pad=8):
    wm_col = wm_col or ink
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = mark_bbox()
    mh = y1 - y0
    scale = (mh * 0.34) / XHEIGHT            # wordmark x-height vs mark height
    gap = mh * 0.22
    wm, wm_w, _ = wordmark(col=wm_col)
    wm_x = x1 + gap
    # align wordmark x-height centre with mark centre
    wm_y = (y0 + y1) / 2 - (T + B) / 2 * scale
    body = (mark(ink, mid, pale)
            + f'<g transform="translate({wm_x:.1f},{wm_y:.1f}) scale({scale:.3f})">{wm}</g>')
    vx1 = wm_x + wm_w * scale
    vy0 = min(y0, wm_y + WM_TOP * scale); vy1 = max(y1, wm_y + WM_BOT * scale)
    return svg_doc((x0 - pad, vy0 - pad, vx1 - x0 + 2 * pad, vy1 - vy0 + 2 * pad),
                   body, "Morpha logo, horizontal lockup")

def stacked_svg(ink=INK, mid=MID, pale=CLAY, wm_col=None, tagline=True, pad=10):
    wm_col = wm_col or ink

    wm_y = y1 + mh * 0.16
    body = (mark(ink, mid, pale)
            + f'<g transform="translate({cx - wm_w * scale / 2:.1f},{wm_y - WM_TOP * scale:.1f}) '
              f'scale({scale:.3f})">{wm}</g>')
    vy1 = wm_y + (WM_BOT - WM_TOP) * scale
    if tagline:
        ty = vy1 + 34
        body += (f'<text x="{cx:.1f}" y="{ty:.1f}" text-anchor="middle" '
                 f'font-family="Avenir Next,Helvetica Neue,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif" '
                 f'font-size="17" letter-spacing="7" fill="{wm_col}">GENERATIVE AI</text>')
        vy1 = ty + 6
    return svg_doc((x0 - pad, y0 - pad, mw + 2 * pad, vy1 - y0 + 2 * pad),
                   body, "Morpha logo, stacked lockup")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Brand sheet, app icon, and animation-frame SVGs for Morpha."""
import sys, math
sys.path.insert(0, "src")
from logo import *

X0, Y0, X1, Y1 = mark_bbox()
MW, MH = X1 - X0, Y1 - Y0
FONT = "Avenir Next,Helvetica Neue,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif"
MONO = "SF Mono,Menlo,Consolas,monospace"
LINE = "#DED4C2"
CARD = "#FFFFFF"

def g_mark(x, y, h, ink=INK, mid=MID, pale=CLAY, **kw):
    """Mark with its bbox top-left at (x, y), height h. Returns (svg, width)."""
    s = h / MH
    svg = (f'<g transform="translate({x:.1f},{y:.1f}) scale({s:.4f}) '
           f'translate({-X0:.1f},{-Y0:.1f})">{mark(ink, mid, pale, **kw)}</g>')
    return svg, MW * s

def g_word(x, y_base, s, col=INK):
    wm, _, _ = wordmark(col=col)
    return f'<g transform="translate({x:.1f},{y_base - B * s:.1f}) scale({s:.4f})">{wm}</g>'

def lockup(x, y, mark_h, ink=INK, mid=MID, pale=CLAY, wm_col=None):
    """Horizontal lockup, mark bbox top-left at (x,y). Returns (svg, total_w)."""
    wm_col = wm_col or ink
    s = mark_h / MH
    m_svg, m_w = g_mark(x, y, mark_h, ink, mid, pale)
    ws = s * (MH * 0.34) / XHEIGHT
    gap = MH * 0.22 * s
    wx = x + m_w + gap
    wbase = y + mark_h / 2 + (B - (T + B) / 2) * ws
    return m_svg + g_word(wx, wbase, ws, wm_col), m_w + gap + WM_W * ws

def label(x, y, text, col=GREY, size=25, anchor="start", ls=4, weight=600):
    return (f'<text x="{x}" y="{y}" text-anchor="{anchor}" font-family="{FONT}" '
            f'font-size="{size}" font-weight="{weight}" letter-spacing="{ls}" fill="{col}">{text}</text>')

def body_text(x, y, text, col=GREY, size=28, anchor="start", weight=400, ls=0):
    return (f'<text x="{x}" y="{y}" text-anchor="{anchor}" font-family="{FONT}" '
            f'font-size="{size}" font-weight="{weight}" letter-spacing="{ls}" fill="{col}">{text}</text>')

def construction(x, y, h):
    s = h / MH
    guides = []
    for (cx, cy, r, _, _) in (MAIN, BUD, SPORE):
        guides.append(f'<circle cx="{cx}" cy="{cy}" r="{r}" fill="none" stroke="{STONE}" '
                      f'stroke-width="1.6" stroke-dasharray="7 7"/>')
        guides.append(f'<circle cx="{cx}" cy="{cy}" r="3" fill="{STONE}"/>')
    axis = (f'<line x1="{MAIN[0]-55}" y1="{MAIN[1]+52}" x2="{SPORE[0]+34}" y2="{SPORE[1]-32}" '
            f'stroke="{CLAY}" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-dasharray="2 8" stroke-linecap="round"/>')
    return (f'<g transform="translate({x:.1f},{y:.1f}) scale({s:.4f}) translate({-X0:.1f},{-Y0:.1f})">'
            + axis + mark() + "".join(guides) + "</g>", MW * s)

PALETTE = [("Ink", INK), ("Warm grey", MID), ("Stone", STONE),
           ("Clay", CLAY), ("Sand", SAND), ("Bone", BONE)]

def sheet_svg():
    W, H = 2400, 1680
    p = [f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="{W}" height="{H}" viewBox="0 0 {W} {H}">',
         f'<rect width="{W}" height="{H}" fill="{BONE}"/>']
    # header
    p.append(label(120, 118, "MORPHA — IDENTITY", INK, 30, ls=6))
    p.append(label(2280, 118, "LOGO SHEET · V1", GREY, 24, anchor="end", ls=4, weight=400))
    p.append(f'<line x1="120" y1="152" x2="2280" y2="152" stroke="{LINE}" stroke-width="2"/>')
    # Panel A: primary
    p.append(f'<rect x="120" y="190" width="2160" height="470" fill="{CARD}" stroke="{LINE}"/>')
    svg_lk, w_lk = lockup(0, 0, 300)
    p.append(f'<g transform="translate({(W - w_lk) / 2:.0f},275)">{svg_lk}</g>')
    p.append(label(170, 612, "01 — PRIMARY LOCKUP"))
    p.append(body_text(2230, 612, "custom monoline wordmark", GREY, 25, anchor="end"))
    # Panel B: reversed
    p.append(f'<rect x="120" y="700" width="1060" height="420" fill="{INK}"/>')
    svg_rv, w_rv = lockup(0, 0, 205, BONE, CLAY, STONE, wm_col=BONE)
    p.append(f'<g transform="translate({120 + (1060 - w_rv) / 2:.0f},807)">{svg_rv}</g>')
    p.append(label(170, 1072, "02 — REVERSED", col=CLAY))
    # Panel C: construction
    p.append(f'<rect x="1220" y="700" width="1060" height="420" fill="{CARD}" stroke="{LINE}"/>')
    svg_c, w_c = construction(1310, 775, 265)
    p.append(svg_c)
    tx = 1760
    rows = [("Parent stone", "seed A · growth-ring crescent", INK),
            ("Bud", "seed B · new generation", MID),
            ("Spore", "seed C · released variant", CLAY)]
    for i, (name, note, col) in enumerate(rows):
        yy = 812 + i * 72
        p.append(f'<circle cx="{tx}" cy="{yy - 9}" r="11" fill="{col}"/>')
        p.append(body_text(tx + 32, yy, name, INK, 29, weight=600))
        p.append(body_text(tx + 32, yy + 30, note, GREY, 24))
    p.append(body_text(tx, 1046, "One harmonic pebble function,", GREY, 26))
    p.append(body_text(tx, 1080, "re-seeded — generation as geometry.", GREY, 26))
    p.append(label(1270, 1072, "03 — CONSTRUCTION"))
    # Panel D: palette
    p.append(f'<rect x="120" y="1160" width="700" height="400" fill="{CARD}" stroke="{LINE}"/>')
    p.append(label(170, 1218, "04 — PALETTE"))
    for i, (name, hexv) in enumerate(PALETTE):
        yy = 1242 + i * 50
        stroke = f' stroke="{LINE}"' if hexv in (BONE, SAND) else ""
        p.append(f'<rect x="170" y="{yy}" width="210" height="38" fill="{hexv}"{stroke}/>')
        p.append(body_text(404, yy + 27, name, INK, 26))
        p.append(f'<text x="770" y="{yy + 27}" text-anchor="end" font-family="{MONO}" '
                 f'font-size="24" fill="{GREY}">{hexv}</text>')
    # Panel E: variations
    p.append(f'<rect x="860" y="1160" width="760" height="400" fill="{CARD}" stroke="{LINE}"/>')
    p.append(label(910, 1218, "05 — VARIATIONS"))
    svg_mono, w_mono = lockup(0, 0, 104, INK, INK, INK)
    p.append(f'<g transform="translate(915,1248)">{svg_mono}</g>')
    p.append(body_text(915, 1392, "One-colour", GREY, 24))
    p.append(f'<line x1="910" y1="1414" x2="1570" y2="1414" stroke="{LINE}" stroke-width="2"/>')
    svg_mk, w_mk = g_mark(915, 1432, 104)
    p.append(svg_mk)
    p.append(body_text(915 + w_mk + 40, 1492, "Mark only — social avatar, favicon", GREY, 24))
    # Panel F: clearspace & scale & app icon
    p.append(f'<rect x="1660" y="1160" width="620" height="400" fill="{CARD}" stroke="{LINE}"/>')
    p.append(label(1710, 1218, "06 — CLEARSPACE & SCALE"))
    cs_h = 128; s = cs_h / MH; xu = 24 * s          # x = spore diameter
    cx0, cy0 = 1735, 1248
    svg_cs, w_cs = g_mark(cx0, cy0, cs_h)
    p.append(f'<rect x="{cx0 - xu:.0f}" y="{cy0 - xu:.0f}" width="{w_cs + 2 * xu:.0f}" '
             f'height="{cs_h + 2 * xu:.0f}" fill="none" stroke="{STONE}" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-dasharray="7 7"/>')
    p.append(svg_cs)
    p.append(body_text(cx0 - xu, cy0 - xu - 12, "x", STONE, 24, weight=600))
    p.append(body_text(cx0 - xu, cy0 + cs_h + xu + 34, "x = spore diameter", GREY, 24))
    # app icon (mini)
    ax, ay, asz = 2075, 1248, 150
    p.append(f'<rect x="{ax}" y="{ay}" width="{asz}" height="{asz}" rx="34" fill="{INK}"/>')
    ah = asz * 0.52
    svg_ai, w_ai = g_mark(ax + (asz - (MW * ah / MH)) / 2, ay + (asz - ah) / 2, ah, BONE, CLAY, STONE)
    p.append(svg_ai)
    p.append(body_text(ax + asz / 2, ay + asz + 34, "App icon", GREY, 24, anchor="middle"))
    # scale row
    sy = 1486
    xx = 1712
    for px in (64, 32, 16):
        svg_s, w_s = g_mark(xx, sy - px + 64, px)
        p.append(svg_s)
        p.append(body_text(xx + w_s / 2, sy + 92, f"{px}", GREY, 22, anchor="middle"))
        xx += w_s + 56
    p.append(body_text(2230, sy + 92, "px", GREY, 22, anchor="end"))
    # footer
    p.append(f'<line x1="120" y1="1606" x2="2280" y2="1606" stroke="{LINE}" stroke-width="2"/>')
    p.append(body_text(120, 1648, "Grown, not built — a generative-AI identity in warm neutrals.", GREY, 26))
    p.append(label(2280, 1648, "MORPHA", INK, 24, anchor="end", ls=5))
    p.append("</svg>")
    return "\n".join(p)

def appicon_svg():
    S = 1024
    h = S * 0.54
    svg_m, w_m = g_mark((S - MW * h / MH) / 2, (S - h) / 2, h, BONE, CLAY, STONE)
    return (f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="{S}" height="{S}" viewBox="0 0 {S} {S}">'
            f'<rect width="{S}" height="{S}" rx="232" fill="{INK}"/>{svg_m}</svg>\n')

def frame_svg(t):
    """t in [0,1): one seamless morph cycle."""
    S = 720
    morph = 0.55 * math.sin(2 * math.pi * t)
    bud_shift = 2.4 * math.sin(2 * math.pi * t + 0.7)
    spore_r = 12 + 1.8 * math.sin(2 * math.pi * t + 1.9)
    h = 320
    svg_m, w_m = g_mark((S - MW * h / MH) / 2, 108, h,
                        morph=morph, bud_shift=bud_shift, spore_r=spore_r)
    ws = 372 / WM_W
    word = g_word((S - WM_W * ws) / 2, 596, ws, INK)
    return (f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="{S}" height="{S}" viewBox="0 0 {S} {S}">'
            f'<rect width="{S}" height="{S}" fill="{BONE}"/>{svg_m}{word}</svg>\n')

    open("/tmp/appicon.svg", "w").write(appicon_svg())
    open("/tmp/frame0.svg", "w").write(frame_svg(0.0))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build all Morpha deliverables into ./output/.

SVG files are generated directly. PNG/GIF renders rasterize those SVGs
with macOS `sips` (system SVG renderer) and assemble animation with
ffmpeg. Intermediate frames live in /tmp and are deleted afterwards.
"""
import os, shutil, subprocess, sys

sys.path.insert(0, "src")
from logo import *
import brandsheet

OUT = "output"
TMP = "/tmp/morpha_build"
os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs(TMP, exist_ok=True)

def write(name, text):
    path = os.path.join(OUT, name)
    open(path, "w").write(text)
    print(f"{path}  ({os.path.getsize(path)} bytes)")

def rasterize(svg_text, out_name, tmp_name):
    """SVG (with explicit width/height) -> PNG in output/, via sips."""
    src = os.path.join(TMP, tmp_name)
    open(src, "w").write(svg_text)
    dst = os.path.join(OUT, out_name)
    subprocess.run(["sips", "-s", "format", "png", src, "--out", dst],
                   check=True, capture_output=True)
    print(f"{dst}  ({os.path.getsize(dst)} bytes)")

# --------------------------------------------------------------- SVG set
write("morpha-mark.svg", mark_svg())
write("morpha-logo-horizontal.svg", horizontal_svg())
write("morpha-logo-stacked.svg", stacked_svg())

I created **Morpha**, a logo for a generative AI company built on cell division: a warm-ink parent "pebble" with a knocked-out growth-ring crescent, a grey bud overlapping its upper right, and a pale-clay spore escaping along the same diagonal — one form generating the next. Every shape, including the bowls of the custom monoline lowercase wordmark, is drawn by the same polar-harmonic pebble function with a different seed, so the geometry is literally generative. The palette is warm neutrals only (ink #2B2620, warm grey, stone, clay, sand, bone), flat with no gradients.

Delivered in `./output/` (8 files, all under 2 MB): five SVGs — mark only, horizontal lockup, stacked lockup with "GENERATIVE AI" tagline, one-colour mono, and reversed for dark backgrounds — plus a 2400×1680 brand-sheet PNG (lockups, construction diagram, palette, clearspace and scale tests), a 1024px app-icon PNG, and a 3-second looping GIF in which the stones gently morph and breathe. I verified every file by rendering and inspecting it, including small-size legibility and one-colour/reversed performance. The reproducible source is in `./src/` (`logo.py`, `brandsheet.py`, `build.py`); running `python3 src/build.py` regenerates everything.
